leadText:
----

 
(Japanese: 秋葉原博士 Dr. Akihabara) is a character of the day who appeared in EP038. However, because the seizures caused by the episode caused it to be banned worldwide, he has never appeared in the outside of Japan. His last name is the name of a famous for its electronics stores.

Although not much is known about him, it was revealed that Akihabara created the Pokémon Transfer System. He has blue hair and wears glasses with spirals on the lenses. He is also a little bit eccentric and is thought to be slightly insane. He created two , one a prototype and the other a full model. At the end of the seizure-inducing explosion, Akihabara's house was destroyed, along with his software, disabling him from entering the computer world.
